title: Worker non-deleting destruction
summary: Recover 0x0048DBB0 as a thiscall member: snapshot handle at +8, reset vtable at +0 to 0x009FBE20, call stdcall CloseHandle once, and ignore its result. No free or handle clearing. Direct original disassembly and cleanup callers support destructor-body interpretation.
test_description: Compare recovered member directly to original_worker_destroy for six handles (zero, ordinary, high-bit and invalid sentinels), three initial vtables and three callback results, each twice. Assert exactly one close per call, correct handle and reset vtable visible inside callback, unchanged handle/priority/thread ID, surrounding guards and bytewise equal final objects.
known_limits: CloseHandle is a controlled callback; actual Windows handle lifetime and OS behavior are not tested.
Windows FS/SEH and exception unwinding through cleanup thunks are not tested.
Null or inaccessible this is outside the valid object contract; original would fault.
Original incidental EAX CloseHandle result is not modeled as a return value of this void destructor body.
Vtable value is original binary identity only; remaining class members and full class hierarchy are unresolved. No byte-matching claim.
